title: Carbon and nitrogen stable isotope analysis in harbor seal pup fur
author: Juan Carlos Herguera-García
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2m3gc8n
materials: CICESE’s laboratory protocol for stable isotope analysis

steps.title: Prepare fur samples for analysis
steps.instruction: Grind harbor seal pup fur, store the ground material in a dissecator, and load the aliquots into a Costech® Carrousel before analysis.

substeps.instruction: Grind the fur to a fine powder suitable for isotopic determination.
Place the ground powder in a dissecator for temporary storage.
Load the stored sample into the Costech® Carrousel.

steps.title: Combust samples in elemental analyzer
steps.instruction: Combust the loaded fur samples at 1000 °C in a pure oxygen atmosphere using an elemental analyzer coupled to a Finnigan MAT Delta V Advantage continuous‑flow stable isotope mass spectrometer.

steps.title: Verify isotopic measurement accuracy
steps.instruction: Run secondary standard reference materials alongside the samples to confirm accuracy of δ13C and δ15N values.
